name: Generations Millwork
old_description: We have been proudly serving all of your custom fixture needs in Oklahoma since 1990. Greet your visitors with our unique custom-designed doors. Get in touch with us today to find the type of door you're looking for.
about:
Generation III, operating as Generations Millwork, is a family-owned carpentry and millwork shop based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in April 1990 by Chuck Clowers, initially working as carpenters and home builders. Their first project was a large home in Oakdale Farms, after which they opened a dedicated shop to focus on cabinetry, furniture, and trim work.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, doors, mantels, wine cellars, tables, closet and media units, and other millwork. Residential projects account for roughly 50% of business, commercial cabinetry for 30%, and creative specialty pieces for the remaining 20%. Work ranges from full custom homes to individual bathroom vanities, pergolas, and entry gates. The company has also completed interior fit-outs for custom coaches, buses, yachts, and train cars. Commercial projects have included banks and law offices spanning 1,500 to 15,000 square feet.

Clients include residential homeowners, commercial developers, and owners of luxury vehicles and vessels. The firm has served banks, law offices, and private clients seeking custom interiors for coaches, buses, yachts, and rail cars.

The company emphasizes problem-solving, service, creativity, and maintaining the highest standard of quality. It backs its work with warranties and a satisfaction guarantee, drawing on over 38 years of experience.
